response.original_title: The Cremation of Sam McGee: A Poem by Robert W. Service
response.overview: A prospector struggles through extreme Arctic cold and promises his dying companion, Sam McGee, that he will cremate his remains. A 12-minute animated short film based on Robert W. Service’s famous 1907 Yukon poem.
response.title: The Cremation of Sam McGee: A Poem by Robert W. Service
